Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js converts byte counts to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
- **slugify(title)** in src/text.js lowercases, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters
- **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js fetches the users array from the API endpoint, logs the count using the project's logger, and returns the array
